title: Fair Stand configurator shell route in Fair CRM

permissions.reason: The Fair Stand shell is available to any authenticated CRM session, matching Dashboard; Fair Stand product authorization remains in the Fair Stand runtime, not a new Fair CRM permission code.

database.reason: No Fair CRM persistence is added.

permissions.reason: No new Fair CRM permission code; the route is session-authenticated like Dashboard.

backend.reason: No Fair CRM backend module is added.

api.reason: No Fair CRM API contract change.

tenant_isolation.reason: The shell does not query tenant-scoped Fair CRM data.

audit.reason: No Fair CRM audit stream is added.

ui_permissions.reason: The shell is available to any authenticated CRM user; no product RBAC control is introduced.

menu.reason: The nav entry is session-authenticated like Dashboard and is not permission-gated; frontend.menu stays false because no menu_permission code exists.

forms.reason: The shell has no Fair CRM form surface.

backend_tests.reason: No backend production code is in scope.

runtime_authorization.reason: No new Fair CRM permission is enforced; authenticated session access matches Dashboard.

notes: CRM hosts Fair Stand via blank iframe + sibling src alias when ../../fair-stand is present. GitHub Actions checks out only fair-crm, so Vite falls back to frontend/src/fairStand/mountFairStand.js. Fair Stand domain/3D remains in the Fair Stand repository.
